verdict.rationale: Codegen documents its own issue-tracker integrations: a Linear connection that enables 'agent interactions with your issues', and agent actions in Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com. Its agent-behavior settings also suggest the agent can be triggered by explicit mentions in comments. However, no evidence explicitly shows a developer assigning or delegating an existing ticket to the agent and having it start coding from that ticket. missing for 10: explicit documentation of assigning or delegating an issue to the agent, a description of the ticket-to-coding-task workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Connect your Linear workspace to enable agent interactions with your issues.
Update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues, and create new tasks. Support for Jira, Linear, Clickup and Monday.com.
Agent only responds to comments containing explicit mentions
